scope: Italy V9 second-pass evidence audit after completion of the first nominative sweep

firstPassAudit.policy: Do not return to partial/blocked CPOs until every canonical CPO has been investigated at least once; this condition is now satisfied.

investigations.result: fail-closed remains correct; no EMOBITALY-wide direct tariff can be inferred
positiveEvidence: Current EMOBITALY Interparking portal exposes a deterministic direct/ad-hoc tariff for that specific managed subnetwork: 0.58 EUR/kWh VAT included.
The same portal exposes a fixed session-start fee whose current range is 0.50-1.40 EUR VAT included and explicitly separates roaming-provider pricing.
Interparking connectors are Type 2 with maximum 22 kW, proving a directly rankable subnetwork only when an EMOBITALY EVSE can be deterministically mapped to Interparking.
negativeEvidence: EMOBITALY operates/hosts charging infrastructure for multiple owners and the Interparking tariff is explicitly scoped to that service, not proven network-wide for all EMO partyId EVSE.
No deterministic mapping of all 849 PUN EMO EVSE to Interparking versus other managed owners was established in this run.

coveredSubpopulation.rule: Only EVSE deterministically identified as Interparking-managed may inherit the Interparking tariff.
coveredSubpopulation.reason: PUN EVSE-to-Interparking mapping not yet established.

investigations.resumeCondition: Enumerate the EMOBITALY public/native station backend and map PUN EVSE IDs to managed owner/subnetwork and exact current tariff before promotion.

investigations.result: fail-closed remains correct for energy price

negativeEvidence: The public tariff page does not expose a current deterministic energy EUR/kWh value for the pay-as-you-go offer in the fetched public view.

investigations.result: station/site-specific pricing confirmed; no network-wide promotion
positiveEvidence: Edison Next announced on 2026-04-30 a specific Galbusera Agrate Brianza site with a launch promotion of 0.59 EUR/kWh VAT included on DC chargers, payable by POS or EVWAY app.
The publication explicitly scopes the price to the new site and to DC chargers, supporting site/class-specific rather than universal pricing.
negativeEvidence: No current Edison Next nationwide direct tariff grid applicable to all 826 EDN EVSE was found.
The Galbusera launch promotion must not be extrapolated to other EDN locations or AC connectors.
